title: Workflow configuration
description: Profile workflow catalog declarations. Structural validation does not confer authority or readiness; Control must validate reference closure, tenant scope, grants and dependencies.

argumentBindings.description: Maps tool argument names to the immutable admitted run message. Bound names must not also occur in arguments; no executable expressions are supported.

WorkflowContextSource.description: Profile declaration for WorkflowContextSource; eligibility and configuration confer no runtime authority.

WorkflowExecutionLimits.description: Profile declaration for WorkflowExecutionLimits; eligibility and configuration confer no runtime authority.

WorkflowGroupDefinition.description: Profile declaration for WorkflowGroupDefinition; eligibility and configuration confer no runtime authority.

standby.description: Retain an unattached provider group in portable bot bundles. A standby group cannot be bound to a workflow or agent until explicitly activated.

WorkflowModelGroupDefinition.description: Ordered model candidates; selection intersects this order with the pinned workflow ceiling. Only provider inference failures permit fallback; effects are never retried.

WorkflowAgentDefinition.description: Profile declaration for WorkflowAgentDefinition; eligibility and configuration confer no runtime authority.

WorkflowAgentBinding.description: Profile declaration for WorkflowAgentBinding; eligibility and configuration confer no runtime authority.

agentStages.description: Optional fixed ordered stages. First input is the admitted message, subsequent inputs are the previous completed result; the last result is the workflow result.

WorkflowDefinition.description: Profile declaration for WorkflowDefinition; eligibility and configuration confer no runtime authority.

WorkflowRemediationMode.description: Profile declaration for WorkflowRemediationMode; eligibility and configuration confer no runtime authority.

WorkflowDispatchBinding.description: Profile declaration for WorkflowDispatchBinding; eligibility and configuration confer no runtime authority.

WorkflowConfiguration.description: Profile declaration for WorkflowConfiguration; eligibility and configuration confer no runtime authority.

WorkflowDispatchRequest.description: A delivered subscription cursor for server-side workflow admission. Caller/event fields cannot select tenant, workflow, version, identity or prompts.

WorkflowDispatchDisposition.description: A durably recorded dispatch outcome. An HTTP/auth/transport failure without a matching receipt never permits acknowledgement.

WorkflowDispatchReceipt.description: Durable admission evidence bound to this subscription UID and delivered cursor. ADMITTED requires runId; DUPLICATE returns its original durable outcome reference and runId when one exists. Terminal rejection/filtering is recorded, never inferred locally.

WorkflowProfileReviewRequest.description: Workflow profile lifecycle metadata; publication requires current authorization, reviewed content and dependency readiness.

WorkflowProfilePublishRequest.description: Workflow profile lifecycle metadata; publication requires current authorization, reviewed content and dependency readiness.

WorkflowProfileStatus.description: Workflow profile lifecycle metadata; publication requires current authorization, reviewed content and dependency readiness.

WorkflowProfileState.description: DRAFT and REVIEWED revisions are unavailable to runs; PUBLISHED identifies the activated revision, not cached runtime authority.

WorkflowModelDeployment.description: An explicitly assigned model deployment. Only server-owned TLS origin, model name and vault reference are configuration; no provider key reaches a runner.

WorkflowAgentResultMode.description: Fixed stage completion source; context contains only confirmed configured reads.

WorkflowAgentStage.description: Ordered configured agent stage; identifiers and modes are data, never executable expressions.

WorkflowModelGeneration.description: Explicit bounded inference parameters selected from the pinned model deployment, never from a runner request.

reasoningEffort.description: Optional provider-supported reasoning control; none disables reasoning for the local structured-output demo.

WorkflowStackRuntime.description: Workflow-scoped operator deployment data; structural configuration confers no runtime authority.

WorkflowStackPlatform.description: Workflow-scoped operator deployment data; structural configuration confers no runtime authority.

WorkflowStackModelEngine.description: Workflow-scoped operator deployment data; structural configuration confers no runtime authority.

config.description: Opaque package configuration, validated against the selected signed trigger descriptor by Control.

eventFilter.description: Subscription CEL filter evaluated by Control; no watch-specific filter is supplied by the operator.

WorkflowStackTriggerSource.description: Workflow-scoped operator deployment data; structural configuration confers no runtime authority.

WorkflowStackFolderAgent.description: Workflow-scoped operator deployment data; structural configuration confers no runtime authority.

WorkflowStackMonitoring.description: Workflow-scoped operator deployment data; structural configuration confers no runtime authority.

WorkflowStackDeployment.description: Complete workflow-scoped local deployment declaration. Operator images and custody remain explicitly trusted; this grants no model or tool authority.

WorkflowStackMonitoringImages.description: Explicit workflow monitoring service images; credentials remain external custody references.

WorkflowGraphSelection.description: Pinned operator-installed native LangGraph factory. Configuration grants no runtime authority.

WorkflowJsonNodeKind.description: Installed JSON node operations. Unsupported executable extensions are refused, never evaluated from profile text.

WorkflowJsonBranchRoutes.description: Boolean branch destinations in the configured graph.

WorkflowJsonNode.description: Pure node declaration; per-run capabilities are injected by the runtime, never captured in topology.

WorkflowJsonEdge.description: One edge or explicit all-predecessor join. START and END are reserved boundary names.

WorkflowJsonGraph.description: Versioned, bounded JSON topology for the installed generic LangGraph compiler. Structure alone establishes no execution authority.

WorkflowGraphBuildRequest.description: Control-authorized immutable candidate reference. Contains no arbitrary Python, paths, secrets or live clients.

WorkflowGraphBuildResult.description: Compilation receipt; this neither publishes configuration nor grants runtime authority.

WorkflowGraphCandidate.description: Reviewed immutable graph candidate read by a verified tenant runtime service. Carries configuration only, never execution credentials.

WorkflowGraphCapabilities.description: Actual JSON compiler features and disposable cache statistics. This is not a readiness or execution grant.

WorkflowWorkerCapabilities.description: Authenticated worker capabilities. Control only leases runs pinned to this compiler and an installed graph digest; this grants no model or tool authority.

instanceId.description: Unique worker process instance, stable across polling and credential refresh; not an authorization token.

WorkflowRunStartRequest.description: Explicit text input for one published bot. Backend derives service group and configured mode; current authority and idempotency remain required.

WorkflowRunStartReceipt.description: Durable acceptance receipt; it is not evidence of execution success.

WorkflowRunProgressRequest.description: Lease-authenticated structural runtime observation. No input, output, provider text or credential is retained in progress evidence.

WorkflowRunProgressEvent.description: Backend-recorded structural progress. Runtime reports do not attest tool effects or finality.

WorkflowRunProgressPage.description: Ordered durable progress for one tenant/run; cursor advances only through returned events.

WorkflowProfileDiagnostics.description: Current tenant-scoped publication blockers, without credentials or remote payloads. Observational only; publication rechecks readiness.

WorkflowModelResolveRequest.description: Gateway-only resolution of one authorized inference candidate, with current authority checked on every attempt.

resultSchema.description: Pinned agent or workflow finish-result schema; local references only, never authority.

WorkflowModelResolveResponse.description: Private Gateway response; credentials must never be forwarded to runtime workers or logged.

ApplicationPasswordLoginRequest.description: V1 existing-user password login. Tenant is required in Toolgate-Tenant-ID; OAuth is not required.

ApplicationAccessToken.description: Short-lived signed user/tenant access token. Obtain a new token through password login after expiry.

WorkflowUserAuthority.description: Control-owned manual-run user and admitted resource ceiling, including a universal human/secret scope when admitted under live tenant Super Admin membership. Current grants or Super Admin membership and identity must still be checked. Never accepted from an external caller.

ApplicationEventSource.description: V1 external application ApplicationEventSource contract; current tenant and user authorization remain required.

ApplicationEventKind.description: V1 external application ApplicationEventKind contract; current tenant and user authorization remain required.

ApplicationEvent.description: Durable structural notification. RESULT announces an available result; read the separately authorized result endpoint for private output.

ApplicationEventPage.description: Bounded durable source events in sequence order. Cursors are scoped to one authorized source.

ApplicationWebhookCreate.description: Caller-owned HTTPS notification subscription. Source ID is a run ID or trigger assignment name. Verification and current source permissions are required before delivery.

ApplicationWebhookDelivery.description: Signed webhook delivery envelope. Use subscriptionId to select the signing key, verify timestamp and raw-body signature, then deduplicate by event.eventId.

ApplicationWebhookState.description: V1 external application ApplicationWebhookState contract; current tenant and user authorization remain required.

ApplicationWebhook.description: Caller-owned registration metadata; no signing key or user token is exposed.

ApplicationWebhookRegistration.description: Registration response, including a private per-subscription signing secret. Exact authenticated retries may recover the same secret; it is encrypted at rest and absent from list/read responses.

ApplicationWebhookPage.description: V1 external application ApplicationWebhookPage contract; current tenant and user authorization remain required.

ApplicationWebhookChallenge.description: Signed destination-ownership challenge. Return HMAC-SHA256(secret, verify.subscriptionId.challenge) using the supplied subscription ID and challenge as proof.

ApplicationWebhookVerificationProof.description: V1 external application ApplicationWebhookVerificationProof contract; current tenant and user authorization remain required.

ApplicationTriggerStatus.description: Structural status for one readable trigger assignment, without configuration or source event payloads.
